## Test

Testing, testing, ... 🎤

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(logolink)
```

```{r}
model_path <- here("nlogox", "test.nlogox")
```

```{r}
setup_file <- create_experiment(
  name = "Test",
  setup = 'setup',
  go = 'go',
  metric = '[value] of patches',
  file = here("xml", "test.xml")
)
```

```{r}
setup_file |> inspect_experiment()
```

```{r}
results <-
  model_path |>
  run_experiment(
    setup_file = setup_file
  )
```

```{r}
results |> glimpse()
```
